card.unit: Follows a large animated number with a '+' (e.g. '4+ years of experience'). {unit} chooses years or months; {count} is the number for plural agreement.
card.percent: <n></n> is replaced by an animated number; place the % sign as your language does.
label.ready: Screen-reader name of a clickable card. It must contain the card's visible words in order (eyebrow, figure, legend, 'View breakdown'). {split} is a following sentence, already including its leading space.
label.degraded: As label.ready, for when part of the data could not be loaded. The parenthesis is spoken but is not visible text.
modal.totalUnit: Very short label under a ring's number: abbreviations of years/months ('yrs'/'mo').
modal.roleDuration: <n></n> is an animated number; 'yrs' / 'mo' are abbreviations and the '+' means 'at least'.
modal.roleAt: {role} is a job title and {company} an employer, both from a résumé (not translated). <muted> styles the company part.
duration: 'At least N years/months' — the '+' means 'at least'. Used inside the change banner ('4+ years → 5+ years').
